description: This file defines the main React component 'VotingDashboard' for an end-to-end voting dashboard application. It imports various UI components, hooks, and manages state and data fetching for KPIs, voting data, leaderboards, recent votes, winners, and recent apps. It also sets up real-time updates and renders the dashboard layout with multiple sections including KPI tiles, charts, feeds, and informational cards.

methods.name: VotingDashboard
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the voting dashboard with KPIs, charts, feeds, and other UI elements.
